name: The Golf Club at Bradshaw Farm

source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Oct 10 2026), filtered like the app's Overpass query: 26 hole ways, greens, tees, bunkers, fairways, water. A green, tee, bunker, fairway or hazard is kept within 150 m of a hole line; woods and water within 100 m. OSM tags the holes 'Blue/White' 1-18 and 'Red' 1-9, with no nine names the app can read; here each hole is named for its nine ('Red 3', 'White 4', 'Blue 7') and numbered 1-27 in card order (Red 1-9, White 10-18, Blue 19-27), so the nine map is read off the names and the Course holes screen never asks. Blue/White 1-9 is the Blue nine and 10-18 the White nine: pars and handicaps match the printed card (4/23) hole for hole.
source.traced: Not in OSM, traced from Esri World Imagery z19 (~0.25 m/px, Wayback 63116, the Nov 2025 photo this file flew until v22.54): White 4 (the par 3, OSM's missing 13): line from the back pad to the green centre, three round tee pads, the green and its two bunkers (pads measure ~186 / 151 / 120 yds to the green centre; card Blue 190, White 155, Red 119); White 3's green and its two bunkers (OSM's line ended in fairway with no green); the pond between White 4 and White 5. White 4's green re-traced Oct 11 (v22.54, D125) from the putting surface's colour on the Sep 2023 photo (release 41468): ~900 m² with its back-right lobe, which the first trace (~710 m²) missed. Two OSM bunkers removed (v22.54, Brett Oct 11): right of Red 9's green and beside Blue 7's, no sand inside either outline on the 2023 or the 2025 photo.
source.caveat: As accurate as OSM; the traced shapes are by eye from the photo, not surveyed. Woods: OSM maps two pieces; v22.55 (D126) adds 53 traced automatically around the Red and White nines (within 75 m of their hole lines) from the Sep 2023 photo: darker and more textured than the course's own turf, pieces over 250 m², kept off mapped fairways, greens, tees, bunkers and water, and 20 m clear of every Red and White tee. Tree edges within a few yards; the Blue nine still has OSM's two pieces only. Re-check White 3 and White 4 the first time they are played.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B2_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).
source.fairways: OSM's, 7 of them grown where the winter Esri photo (Wayback 63116: dormant rough, green fairway) reads fairway past OSM's edge — d′ ≥ 2.8, log-likelihood ≥ 6, pieces ≥ 150 m² touching OSM's fairway, never into the lidar trees (scripts/bradshaw-fairways/, D135); q "osm+photo".

imagery.release: Cherokee County's 6-inch orthophoto (winter, bare trees, the greens under dark frost covers; the county's 2025 flight by its Aerial2025 service), Cherokee County GIS's public image service, one 512-px export per 256-px tile. No licence stated (P10, D140; Brett Oct 23: build now, ask the county later).
